notes.title: Yet another update!
notes.content: Light switches moved further from doors where both can be triggered at once.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Screen Res issues fixed.
Player's 'nightlight' removed - extended flashlight life is enough.
Added 'How To Play' guide to menu as this game is more of a thinker than it first appears.

notes.title: Removed excessive head bobbing in response to player feedback.
notes.content:
Removed excessive head bobbing in response to player feedback.

Apologies for any nausea caused!
